observations.why: Directive issued by the position-holder establishing a recurring cadence as mandate, combining authority of role with insistence on compliance.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Logical equivalence framed as a maxim to persuade that unrehearsed rollbacks are effectively nonexistent — controlling the factual frame through argument.
Asserting cadence as a labeled parameter reinforces the directive's authority — the owner setting operational tempo by position.
Self-assigning the owner label claims positional authority over the rehearsal process, a legitimate-power marker.
